PROP formula sheet On-design cycle analysis, propellers and turbomachinery

T1 on-design analysis (turbojet, turbofan, mixed turbofan and afterburner, turboshaft, turboprop, propfan), T2 compressors, T3 turbines; exercises 1A-3B. The partial allows a 2-sheet cheat sheet (4 faces, free format, handed in): this PDF fills the 4 A4 faces (print it double-sided on 2 sheets). Formulas, then the exercise recipes with shortcut forms, then data tables and the exercise reference values. Exam: Mon 2 Nov (Visor) or Thu 5 Nov 2026 (Atenea), 15:00.

Gas, totals and mass flow

Mixed exhaust, mixer and afterburner

Long-duct turbofan: fan duct πfd = Pt16/Pt13 = 0.98-0.99, τfd = 1. Kutta condition at the splitter: P6 = P16; design approximation Pt6 ≈ Pt16 closes the cycle, so the bypass ratio becomes an OUTPUT.

Common slips

Choked ratio exponent is γ/(γ-1) (1.832), not γ/(γ+1). e divides for compressors, multiplies for turbines. Fan work uses ALL the flow ṁ0. ηg multiplies BOTH the LPT and LPC terms of W_prop. Mechanical losses are charged to the turbine (W_c = ηm W_t). Hot stations use R_t, γt, cp_t. Pt in Pa inside MFP and A. The ηn route refers to Pt5, the πn route to Pt9. ηP with the full thrust, ηO = v0/(h_PR TSFC) as a check. Propeller: W_D, not W_prop, in dEk; check ηL ≤ 1 and FM ≤ 1. Turbine v3 is positive AGAINST U. Round n_s UP.
